# Desert & River

> Desert & River runs slow, ethical, small-group and private desert journeys in the Sinai, Egypt, based in Dahab. Trips are led by Joseph and Annet together, with local Bedouin guides, and range from a single day to custom itineraries of up to 40 days. Trips are guided in English. Contact: WhatsApp +201063864837, email info@desertandriver.com.

The website is available in English, Dutch (/nl/), German (/de/), Arabic (/ar/) and Hebrew (/he/).

## About

- [About Joseph & Annet](https://desertandriver.com/about): who guides the trips, their approach to ethics, permits and long-term Bedouin relationships
- [FAQ](https://desertandriver.com/faq): booking, safety, fitness, permits, packing, wildlife and more
- [Contact](https://desertandriver.com/contact): WhatsApp, email or book a call

## Trips from Dahab

- [1-day Arada safari](https://desertandriver.com/trip-1-day-arada-safari): Arada (Double) Canyon and the Nawamis tombs
- [1-day camel ride & canyon hike](https://desertandriver.com/trip-1-day-camel-trip): camel ride and hike through Hamata Canyon
- [2 days / 1 night desert camping](https://desertandriver.com/trip-2-day-1-night): canyons, fossils, Nawamis tombs and a night under the stars
- [2-day overnight camel trek](https://desertandriver.com/trip-2-day-camel-trek): Ein Hudra oasis and the Closed Canyon by camel
- [3-day desert safari](https://desertandriver.com/trip-3-day-desert-safari): includes Serabit el-Khadim temple
- [6-day Melahis camel trip](https://desertandriver.com/trip-6-day-camel-trip): 6 days / 5 nights by camel
- [8-day Sinai Discovery program](https://desertandriver.com/trip-8-day-sinai-discovery): 8 days / 7 nights across the Sinai
- [All ready-to-book packages](https://desertandriver.com/ready-to-book-trips)
- [Day tours](https://desertandriver.com/day-tours)
